bio: A tadpole with a shoelace for a tail and a tick painted on its side. It does laps of the puddle before anyone has said go, and it has never once stopped to tie itself.
Its legs grew in all at once and it has not stood still since. It leaps from roof to roof on winged feet, shouting a three-word slogan nobody remembers agreeing to.
